Send usage events from your app and bill them through meters. An event names a customer by any key your app already has (a user, workspace or API key id) or by the customer id. Its own `key` makes every send safe to retry: a repeat is a duplicate and counts once.

A **meter** says what to count: an event name, an aggregation, optional filters and up to five group-by properties. A **price** on the meter bills each combination of group values from a rate card with a default rate, at up to 12 decimal places, or passes through the event's own amount or cost plus a markup. Usage closes about 6 minutes after a period ends; an event that arrives later bills on the next invoice as usage from its own period.

## Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/usage`](/help/developers/api-reference/usage/usage-by-day-for-one-customer) | Usage by day for one customer |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/usage_keys`](/help/developers/api-reference/usage/list-a-customer-s-usage-keys) | List a customer's usage keys |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/usage_keys`](/help/developers/api-reference/usage/add-a-usage-key) | Add a usage key |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/usage_keys/remove`](/help/developers/api-reference/usage/remove-a-usage-key) | Remove a usage key |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/meters`](/help/developers/api-reference/usage/list-meters) | List meters |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/meters`](/help/developers/api-reference/usage/create-a-meter) | Create a meter |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/meters/{meter}`](/help/developers/api-reference/usage/retrieve-a-meter) | Retrieve a meter |
| `PATCH` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/meters/{meter}`](/help/developers/api-reference/usage/update-a-meter) | Update a meter |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/meters/{meter}/archive`](/help/developers/api-reference/usage/archive-a-meter) | Archive a meter |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/usage_events`](/help/developers/api-reference/usage/list-usage-events) | List usage events |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/usage_events`](/help/developers/api-reference/usage/send-a-usage-event) | Send a usage event |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/usage_events/batch`](/help/developers/api-reference/usage/send-up-to-500-usage-events) | Send up to 500 usage events |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/usage_events/void`](/help/developers/api-reference/usage/void-a-usage-event) | Void a usage event |
